2-1/16" Round Universal HDX Clock


From Dakota Digital HDX

This universal HDX clock unit must be connected to any HDX control box. The compact 2-1/16” mounting-hole diameter makes this clock easy to mount. Choose from black or silver face styling.

Bezel shape and 2 5/16” overall diameter make it a perfect match to the HDX-2024 package.

Dimensions:
Cutout: 2-1/16"
Overall: 2-5/16"

**HLC cannot be used as a standalone clock.
